name: injectconsole-dbg
help: Debug build: same as injectconsole, writes stage/timing log to %TEMP%\injectconsole.log
long_help: Identical to injectconsole but compiled with IC_LOG. Progress and timing are appended to %TEMP%\injectconsole.log on the target, so you can see which stage hung if the BOF never returns.

commands.help: Debug build of injectconsole, logs stages to %TEMP%\injectconsole.log

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Path to an interactive console executable (e.g. C:\Windows\System32\netsh.exe)

arguments.name: shellcode
arguments.desc: File containing the raw shellcode blob (must avoid 0x0a, 0x0d, 0x1a)

arguments.name: method
arguments.desc: Injection method: hijack (default, RIP hijack) or thread (CreateRemoteThread)
